svg.title: Short rows for a tapered tumbler sleeve
svg.desc: A sideways strip 18 stitches tall. Rows run from the top edge to the bottom edge. In the middle, a wedge of short rows: two rows over the top 12 stitches and two more over the top 6. The top edge ends up with 39 rows, 7.8 inches at 5 rows per inch, the middle with 37, and the bottom with 35, 7.0 inches. That matches a cup 9.3 inches around at the top and 8.5 at the bottom, less 1.5 inches for the handle.
svg.text: Short rows add length to the top edge only
The wedge, worked from the top edge after row 17:
sc 12, turn; sc 12, turn; sc 6, turn; sc 6, turn.
Cup (example): 9.3 in around at the top, 8.5 at the bottom.
Minus 1.5 in for the handle: 7.8 in and 7.0 in of strip.
